items.title: Xsolla AI Toolkit and vendor-authored agent skills
items.summary: The productivity radar points to secondary coverage of an Xsolla toolkit. Find and read the vendor documentation or repository before using any claim. First-attempt integration success is an untested vendor claim.
items.decision: Check whether an official skill exists for the API being integrated and what it validates.
items.example_idea: Validate a documented integration contract against fixed fixtures, without paid services or production transactions.

items.title: Agent access controls beyond a classifier
items.summary: The productivity radar cites an Anthropic report and infers an architecture combining identity, permissions and classifiers. Verify the source statement and label the architecture as an inference.
items.decision: Evaluate deterministic authorization checks before agent tool calls.
items.example_idea: Test allow/deny policy decisions with benign synthetic users, permissions and tool requests; measure denied unauthorized requests.
items.availability: Research lead; no new product release established.

items.title: Compare prompt-only, skill-based and skill-plus-eval workflows
items.summary: Editorial experiment inspired by the productivity radar, not a measured result. Primary implementation references and an actual comparison remain to be established.
items.decision: Determine whether separating reusable instructions and validation helps a fixed task.
items.example_idea: Use fixed task fixtures, deterministic stubs and validation checks; report only structural checks and explicit accounting, not real model accuracy.
